game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Cannon Battery Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Cannon Battery, the harbor cannon battery: the deckhand must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Cannon Battery: the harbor cannon battery
core_gameplay_loop: In Cannon Battery, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round, a new lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the cover value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 600 points of lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cannon Battery'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cannon Battery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 600 within 46 seconds.
